metaTitle: Move-Out Cleaning in Burbank, CA | Tarea
metaDescription: Move-out cleaning for Burbank homes, including older post-war properties with original plumbing. $255–$480, based on $56/hour for 4–8 hours of work.
intro: Move-out cleaning covers the deep clean landlords and new buyers expect once a home is empty, and it often takes longer in Burbank because so many of its post-war single-family homes still have original bathroom and kitchen fixtures. Decades of mineral buildup, old grout, and aging cabinetry mean these cleans take real scrubbing time, not just a quick wipe-down. Getting it done properly can be the difference between a full security deposit refund and a dispute with a landlord.
causes: Original plumbing fixtures in many Burbank homes have decades of hard-water mineral scale on faucets, showerheads, and tile that needs manual scrubbing rather than a quick spray.
Older grout and caulk lines in these homes trap soap scum and grime that has built up over many years of use.
Original cabinetry and built-ins often have layers of cooking grease or dust in corners and tracks that standard weekly cleaning never reaches.
Single-family homes from this era tend to have more square footage per room, including baseboards, window sills, and closets that all need attention at move-out.
Landlord or property management checklists for move-out cleaning are usually stricter than a typical tenant's regular cleaning routine.
whatProDoes: Clean and disinfect all bathroom and kitchen surfaces, including scrubbing mineral deposits off original fixtures where present.
Clean inside and outside of cabinets, drawers, and closets, including any built-in shelving common in older homes.
Vacuum and mop all flooring, and clean baseboards, window sills, and interior window glass.
Clean the inside of the oven, refrigerator, and other major appliances if they are staying in the unit.
Do a final walkthrough to check for any missed spots, especially around older fixtures and tile grout lines.
diyOrPro: Light tasks like wiping counters, vacuuming, and general tidying are safe for most people to do themselves before a move. However, deep scrubbing of decades-old grout, mineral-crusted fixtures, or greasy cabinet interiors takes more time and the right products than most tenants have on hand, and doing a rushed job risks losing part of a security deposit. If you notice signs of a plumbing leak or water staining around original fixtures, that's a separate repair issue and worth mentioning to a landlord before cleaning over it.
priceNote: This job runs $255 to $480 in Burbank, based on a $56 per hour rate for a typical 4 to 8 hour job. Homes with more original fixtures, heavier grime buildup, or larger square footage tend to land toward the higher end of that range.

faqs.q: Will the cleaner remove hard-water stains from old faucets and showerheads?
faqs.a: A pro will scrub mineral buildup with appropriate cleaning products, but some staining on original fixtures may be permanent etching in the metal or tile that cleaning alone can't fully remove.

faqs.q: Does move-out cleaning include the inside of the oven and refrigerator?
faqs.a: Yes, cleaning the interior of major appliances that are staying in the unit is typically part of the job, as noted in the steps a pro performs.

faqs.q: How long will move-out cleaning take for my home?
faqs.a: Most jobs take 4 to 8 hours depending on the size of the home and the condition of original fixtures and surfaces, which is reflected in the $255 to $480 price range.
